title: Prove MCP++ authorization and result parity across transports

authority.statement: AuthorizationGate@1 is the sole dispatch gate for protected MCP tools. UCANVerifier@1 with a durable RevocationLedger@1 and ProfileDPolicyProvider@1 admit effects. Stdio, HTTP, and P2P are framing projections of the same JSON-RPC handler and must not reimplement authorization or storage logic.

transport_entrypoints.http: create_http_app ASGI fixture posting JSON-RPC to /mcp

parity_policy.note: Allowed calls consume distinct UCAN nonces per transport; Profile B decision/intent CIDs bind the envelope digest and are stripped before parity. Denial cases that fail before nonce consumption replay one shared envelope so raw decision event_cid matches. policy_denied verifies then rejects, so only the canonical decision CID (without envelope digest) is required to match.

adversarial_corpus.missing_envelope: authorization_envelope_required; zero dispatch; identical decision CID
adversarial_corpus.policy_denied: Profile D prohibition yields policy_denied before handler
adversarial_corpus.signed_to_unsigned_downgrade: compact token without signature segment fails on every transport
adversarial_corpus.confused_deputy: UCAN audience bound to deputy DID cannot authorize claiming actor
adversarial_corpus.forged_key: token signed by unregistered private key fails closed
adversarial_corpus.revocation_replay_restart: durable RevocationLedger preserves replay and revocation across process restart for every transport

security_evidence_policy.statement: Positive security claims require UCANVerifier@1 over Ed25519 tokens and a durable RevocationLedger@1. MagicMock-only verifiers do not satisfy the gate; this suite constructs real keys, issues signed UCANs, and asserts type(UCANVerifier).
security_evidence_policy.audit_redaction: Bearer tokens, private_input fields, and signature material must not appear in authorization.decision or authorization.effect audit events.

evidence_subset.transport_decision_parity: Identical denial reason and decision event_cid across stdio, HTTP, and P2P for every adversarial case under a frozen authorization clock.
evidence_subset.transport_result_parity: Allowed operations share status, content_cid, version, transaction_cid, and Profile B output_cid after transport normalization.
evidence_subset.zero_dispatch_on_denial: Dispatch spy remains empty for every denial on every transport.
evidence_subset.restart: Replay of a consumed nonce and use of a revoked token_id both deny after ledger reload.
evidence_subset.no_mock_crypto: Harness asserts UCANVerifier and RevocationLedger concrete types; MagicMock is not the security path.
